clips.title: The story
paras: Raising Spirits is a Horde quest in the Arathi Highlands where Tor'gan seeks to lift the spirits of a despondent orc named Gor'mul. When tales of Orgrimmar and Warchief Thrall fail, Tor'gan turns to newly rediscovered shamanic traditions to craft a revitalizing amulet from highland raptor eyes.

At the remote outpost of Hammerfall in the Arathi Highlands, the orcs face enemies from without and quiet battles within. One of their own, Gor'mul, has fallen into a deep, unshakable melancholy. His companions attempted to rally him with proud tales of Kalimdor, the mighty fortress city of Orgrimmar, and the visionary leadership of young Warchief Thrall. Yet none of these grand victories or distant wonders could pierce Gor'mul's gloom or give him reason to hope.

Recognizing that mere words are powerless against Gor'mul's despondency, Tor'gan turns to the Horde's revived spiritual heritage. By gathering the eyes of fierce highland raptors roaming Arathi, Tor'gan crafts an amulet blessed with the predators' spirits. Rather than relying on brute force or fel power, this ritual invokes the restorative strength of newly embraced shamanistic traditions, hoping the beast's vital flame can awaken a brother's dormant will to live.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We tried to settle him in, cheer him up, telling him stories of our mighty city at Orgrimmar in Kalimdor, but nothing would move him.

Tales of our young Warchief, Thrall, who bears the armor and hammer of Orgrim... But, perhaps... Perhaps! A demonstration of our newly found shamanistic magic would give him new hope. It is worth a try!
A small object we could make for him, yes... Bring me some raptor eyes, and I will see what I can do.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I will create an amulet that will give Gor'mul some of the strength of the raptors. Perhaps that will awaken some flame within him...

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent. The spirits of the raptors that gave these eyes will lend strength to the bearer of this amulet.
